body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 2 Radiant Damage and suppress its ordinary concealment until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Learn whether an ordinary illusion is altering the target's visible outline.
On a hit, end one ordinary magical concealment benefit on it.

rider.title: Light Thread
rider.html: Gain a Light Thread. Before rolling a later Magecraft card, consume it: ignore ordinary concealment penalties against its detected targets. This does not detect a hidden creature or bypass solid cover.
